Gordana Siljanovska-Davkova ( Macedonian : Гордана Сиљановска-Давкова; [ 1 ] [ 2 ] [ 3 ] born 11 May 1953) is a Macedonian university law professor and jurist serving as the president of North Macedonia since May 2024. She was a candidate for the 2019 presidential elections , losing to Stevo Pendarovski in the runoff. She ran again in the 2024 presidential elections and defeated Pendarovski by a landslide in a rematch election. She is North Macedonia's first female president .
